title: Support of the image of a measure under a translation
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, mu any measure on the Borel sigma-algebra of R^(n+l) (no finiteness assumption), xi in R^(n+l) and tau(x) = x - xi. Then spt(tau_# mu) = tau(spt mu), where spt nu is the set of points x such that nu(N) > 0 for every neighbourhood N of x (Mathlib Measure.support) and tau_# mu = Measure.map tau mu.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (ξ : Amb n ℓ), (μ.map (fun x => x - ξ)).support = (fun x => x - ξ) '' μ.support
